title: Ashcombe Rising Revisited
author: V. M. Galloway
blurb: Ines Coldharbour, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
